When you hand in, you get a score report with an explanation for every question, and a case paper is graded criterion by criterion. The sample has a case already graded.
分数趋势、未来 14 天的到期复习预测和各主题的掌握程度都在这里，页面底部的「模: The score trend, a 14-day forecast of due reviews and your mastery by topic are here, and “Model usage” at the bottom lists token use by feature. The charts show the sample's three weeks of practice.
按「讲解 → 复述 → 练习」一步步学一个主题，学到一半离开也能接着学。默认用当: Study a topic step by step, from lesson to retelling to practice, and pick up where you left off. It uses the current course's sources by default; to change course, choose “Switch course” after you start. The sample has a flow paused at its lesson.
上百页的大教材，建议先用转换工具变成带页码的文字再导入；整本书出题时，可以让 D: For a textbook of hundreds of pages, convert it to paged text first and then import it; for a whole book, a search tool in DSH can pick out only the relevant pages. Settings › About and updates checks for a new version, and the bottom of the sidebar also says when one is available.
导览用一门示例课程（设计模式）带你看一遍：先走主线（添加资料、出题、练习），再看: The tour uses a sample course on design patterns. It follows the main line first (add a source, make questions, practise), then shows where Jobs and the model settings are. Everything in the sample is marked “Sample”, and you can remove it with one click when you are done.
左侧按用到的频率分成三组：「每天」是每次学习都会用的（学习库、资料、创建题组、任: The sidebar has three groups, by how often you use them. “Every day” holds what you open each session (Study library, Sources, Create deck, Jobs, Mistakes & weak points, Learning flow, Study notes and Tasks; adding a new lecture and making questions each week are here too). “Now and then” is for occasional use (Mock exam, Exam prep and Statistics; Exam prep appears only once DSH has turned it on). “Setup & manage” is for the start of each course or when needed (Knowledge outline, Audio transcription, Live class). Click the heading of the last two groups to fold them. The language and appearance switches are at the bottom, and you can hold an item and drag it to reorder.
资料：先把讲义添加进来: Sources: start by adding your notes
点「添加资料」：PDF、Word、PowerPoint、Markdown、保存下: Choose “Add source”: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Markdown, saved web pages (.html) and plain text all work, and the original file is kept intact; you can also paste text. One document is one source, and a multi-page PDF is not split up. For a textbook of hundreds of pages, you are asked to convert it to text with page numbers first.
阅读器工具栏里的「做这几页的题」会数出这几页关联了多少道题、几道到期，点一下就开: The “Practise these pages” button in the reader’s toolbar counts how many questions are linked to these pages and how many are due, and one click starts them. When these pages have no questions yet, the same button can make some.
工具栏的「翻译」把这一页或这一章译成中文或英文，译文显示在对应段落旁。翻译在后台: The toolbar’s “Translation” button translates this page or chapter into Chinese or English, with each translation shown beside its paragraph. It runs in the background, so you can keep reading, and translations you already have need no model.
翻译需要 AI 模型；已有的译文照常显示。: Translating needs an AI model; translations you already have are still shown.
出题：选好资料就能生成: Make questions: pick sources and generate
勾选要出题的资料，题型、题数和难度保持默认就行，再点这里的生成按钮。AI 出的题: Tick the sources to write questions from; the default question types, count and difficulty are fine. Then press the generate button here. New questions go into a draft first, and you publish after you have checked them.
题型和难度是开关，题数由「覆盖强度」决定（精简、标准或完整），想自己定题数再展开: Question types and difficulty are switches. The count follows the “Coverage strength” (Lean, Standard or Full); open “Custom number of questions” to set your own. Not sure what to practise? Choose “Suggest a focus”: it sends only the source titles and outlines, never the full text, and without a model it suggests from your mistakes instead.
出题、音频转写这类要等一阵的工作在后台进行，可以边等边做别的；进度、暂停、停止和: Work that takes a while, such as making questions or transcribing audio, runs in the background, so you can do something else meanwhile. Progress, pause, stop and retry are all in Jobs.
